question: What permanent inbound QQBot gateway payload ceiling should OpenClaw enforce while preserving legitimate event delivery?
rationale: The code and dependency contract prove that a bound is useful, but neither Tencent's published gateway reference nor authenticated production evidence establishes whether 1 MiB is safely above every valid QQ event.

options.title: Use a 16 MiB ceiling
options.body: Rebase with `maxPayload: 16 * 1024 * 1024`, preserving the merged handshake timeout and gaining a substantial reduction from the 100 MiB dependency default with wider compatibility margin.

options.title: Approve the 1 MiB ceiling
options.body: Keep the proposed value only after QQBot ownership confirms event-size expectations or supplies authenticated proof covering the largest enabled event families.

options.title: Pause for protocol evidence
options.body: Leave the PR open until Tencent guidance, production telemetry, or broader live QQBot testing establishes a defensible ceiling.

recommendation.title: Use a 16 MiB ceiling
recommendation.body: Rebase with `maxPayload: 16 * 1024 * 1024`, preserving the merged handshake timeout and gaining a substantial reduction from the 100 MiB dependency default with wider compatibility margin.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest feature-history connection to the current QQBot gateway architecture and event surface.
